title: Vice Beach Motor Club
description: Race a 3D City ASCII convertible across Vice Beach and Liberty City in circuit or knockout events, chaining drifts, slipstreams, and garage upgrades.
controls: W/S or Up/Down to drive and brake, A/D or Left/Right to steer, hold Space while turning to drift, double-tap Space for nitro, C to switch camera, P/Esc to pause.

zh-CN.title: 罪恶海滩赛车俱乐部
zh-CN.description: 驾驶 3D 字符美学敞篷车驰骋罪恶海滩与自由城双赛道，体验漂移充能、尾流加速、淘汰赛与车库改装。
zh-CN.controls: W/S 或方向上下键油门刹车，A/D 或左右键转向，转弯时按住空格漂移，双击空格释放氮气，C 切换视角，P/Esc 暂停。
